name: @openagt/install
description: Install OpenAgent on this computer: the dashboard starts when you log in, at https://openagent.build, which this computer then answers itself. `npx @openagt/uninstall` takes it all off again.

scripts.prepack: node -e "if(!process.env.npm_config_user_agent?.startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('Pack and publish with pnpm: it replaces workspace:* with the real version, npm does not');process.exit(1)}"
